complete_examples.text: Combining the energy-variational principle with the vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) system, a new framework of train-track system space dynamics is constructed.

However, the vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) research should consider not only the non-linear wheel/rail contact model but also the elastic-plastic behaviour during strong earthquakes, especially for the bearings and piers [19].
